blockingHint: Evicting any pod of these workloads will be rejected right now — a node drain will stall here. Scale them up first, or relax the policy temporarily.

empty.hpa: No HPAs in this cluster. Every workload has a fixed replica count; scaling is manual.
empty.pdb: No PDBs in this cluster. ⚠️ That is not the same as safe — it means nothing protects these workloads during eviction, and a rolling upgrade may take all pods of a service down at once.
empty.pool: No node pools found. Self-managed clusters have no node-pool concept — this is not a collection gap.

hint.hpa: Workloads already at max replicas cannot absorb more traffic
hint.pdb: Check before draining a node: zero-budget entries will block the drain outright
hint.pool: Machine type, count and version — version drift is what you want to catch before an upgrade

notCollected.body: Nothing on this tab can be trusted right now — a blank list means neither "no PDBs" nor "safe to drain". Verify collection is running for this cluster first.
notCollected.title: PDBs have never been collected for this cluster

selectorAll: Empty selector = matches every Pod in the namespace
